metrics.profile_summary: Early-career marketing professional with a strong academic background and experience in digital advertising and data analytics. Specialized in performance tracking across Meta, TikTok, and Google Ads with a focus on ROI and conversion optimization.

experience.description: Tracks platform performance using MS Excel and analyzes creative performance on Google, TikTok, and Meta.
Managed three brand accounts, generating 88 conversions with a ROAS of 8.15.
Improved data collection efficiency by 15% through data cleaning and analytics template creation.
Collaborated on marketing campaigns that increased user engagement by 10%.
Analyzed customer behavior using Excel pivot tables and developed SEO-driven content.

strengths: Direct experience with Meta and TikTok ad platforms
weaknesses: Lacks the minimum 2 years of full-time professional experience
No explicit mention of Canva or social media scheduling tools
evaluation.summary: The candidate meets the educational requirements and possesses strong technical skills in digital advertising and data analysis. However, their experience consists primarily of internships and trainee roles, falling short of the 2-year professional experience threshold.
